verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Change Stack lets you subscribe a pull request to events and carry the review into a Slack or Discord thread. That is event subscription delivered through chat integrations, not documented general-purpose outbound webhooks. An OpenAPI spec exists, but nothing in the evidence shows it exposes webhook registration. Missing for 10: documented outbound webhook endpoints, event catalog/payload schemas, webhook registration API, delivery/retry/signature semantics, independent corroboration.
